text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer, do you have any siblings?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's not really big enough to call a 
worry, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Sometimes, I wonder if my replies 
sound a bit too cold... like... Ah."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't tell the two of them about 
this consultation, okay...!
